orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Strafe Jets Mk3, a small hull mount (outward is up; mount it on a side wall for A/D strafe): wider ringed bells angled outward with a straight micro-nozzle between them, and inside the Mk2 core with a second, smaller gyro and a cable harness. Damaged: the left bell lip dented and hanging, the right bell cracked and sputtering, the gyro glass cracked and stalling, lamps red, sparks. Disabled: both bells bent over at the neck, the micro-nozzle snapped, the gyro dead and cracked, the hatch popped. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
